'''Rory Diabler''' is a Star Wars CCG player who played at [[February 2001 Paxtonia tournament]] on 17 February 2001 with [[Rescue The Princess / Sometimes I Amaze Even Myself|RTP]], according to Drew Scott's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d1738">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2001-02-17-paxtonia-plaza-pa-2-17-01d1738/ paxtonia-plaza-pa-2-17-01], DeckTech (drew "drew man1" scott, 17 February 2001). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2001-02-17-paxtonia-plaza-pa-2-17-01d1738/ GitHub Pages].</ref>
